title: Skrillex Made the Kingdom Hearts III Theme Because He's a Fan
hook:
Eight-time Grammy winner Skrillex co-wrote Face My Fears, the Kingdom Hearts III opening song, with Hikaru Utada, and Square Enix called him a long-time fan of the series. Does it hold up next to Simple and Clean?
Gameplay is from Shards of Irsa, a game I'm making.
script: Did you know the opening song of Kingdom Hearts Three was made by Skrillex? Hikaru Utada has sung the theme for Kingdom Hearts since the very first game in two thousand two. Back then, director Tetsuya Nomura said she was the only artist he could imagine singing it. Her song Hikari became Simple and Clean in English, and fans still sing it today. For the third game, Square Enix paired her with Skrillex, a producer who had already won eight Grammys. Square Enix described him as a long time, self professed fan of the series. The two wrote the song together, and Poo Bear, the producer behind Justin Bieber's What Do You Mean, produced it with them. The result was Face My Fears. Square Enix announced the song in September of twenty eighteen, and it came out the next January. Kingdom Hearts Three itself arrived eleven days later, on January twenty ninth. Utada also gave the game a second song, Don't Think Twice, which serves as its main theme. So a Disney and Final Fantasy crossover opened with a dubstep star behind the board. Not many game soundtracks can say an eight time Grammy winner showed up as a fan. Does Face My Fears belong next to Simple and Clean for you? Follow for more gaming history.
